Summary: The FiNER-139 dataset is divided into three splits: training, validation, and test. The training set contains 900,384 sentences, the validation set contains 112,494 sentences, and the test set contains 108,378 sentences. These splits are detailed in the dataset cards on Hugging Face and the GitHub repository, as well as in the ACL paper.
